title: Service Accounts and Repair Orders Shop Fee Schedule
content:
Posted shop fees of **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**, by tier. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Tier | Shop supplies (share of customer-pay labor after discount) | Shop supplies cap per repair order | Hazardous waste fee | Tire disposal fee per scrap tire | Free storage days after the completion notice | Storage fee per further day | Mobile service radius (one-way miles) | Mobile service trip fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 8% | 49.95 | 4.95 | 3.50 | 3 | 35.00 | 15 | 49.95 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 8% | 49.95 | 4.95 | 3.50 | 3 | 35.00 | 15 | 49.95 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 6% | 39.95 | 4.95 | 3.50 | 3 | 35.00 | 20 | 29.95 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 0% | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3.50 | 3 | 35.00 | 25 | 0.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 5% | 35.00 | 4.95 | 3.50 | 3 | 25.00 | 30 | 0.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 5% | 35.00 | 4.95 | 3.50 | 3 | 25.00 | 30 | 0.00 |

**Reading the schedule.**
- A 0% or 0.00 entry is a fee that works out to nothing for that tier.
- The shop supplies share is the share of the repair order's customer-pay labor after discount; the cap is the most that fee can come to on one repair order.
- Hypothetical: at Kessler Owner Rewards Gold, customer-pay labor after discount of 410.00 gives 6% of it, 24.60, which is under the 39.95 cap; labor of 900.00 gives 54.00, held to 39.95.
